notes.title: Nezori is now on Kickstarter – Play the Demo Today!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665260/877ffbbf7ebf0f03438c8e059a4f7f7e634f26c3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Nezori is now live on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/visualnoveler/nezori-fantasy-action-rpg-with-cute-animal-eared-girls"]Kickstarter![/url][/b][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that a playable demo covering the opening sections of the game is now available for you to try. We’ve also released a new trailer, which you can watch on the game’s Steam store page.[/p][p]If you enjoy stories featuring cute kemonomimi characters like fox girls and wolf girls, this is the perfect time to check it out![/p]
